title: Calendar Weekly Daily-Style View - Mode Visibility - New weekly daily-style mode is available
description: Core availability — Staff can access the new weekly calendar mode that renders a 7-day range in Daily View layout.
preconditions:
- Logged in as staff user with calendar access.
- Calendar feature build includes LT-103679.
steps_actions:
1. Open Lesson Calendar.
2. Open the view mode selector.
3. Observe the available modes.
steps_result:
1. Calendar landing page is displayed.
2. Existing calendar view options are shown.
3. A new weekly daily-style view option is visible and selectable.
steps_data:
1. surface = lesson_calendar
2. action = open_view_selector
3. expected_mode = weekly_daily_style

title: Calendar Weekly Daily-Style View - Teacher Filter Required - Selecting a teacher loads the 7-day schedule
description: Core flow — After selecting a teacher, the calendar shows that teacher's 7-day schedule in Daily View layout.
preconditions:
- Logged in as staff user with calendar access.
- Weekly daily-style mode is available.
- Teacher T1 has lessons in the target week.
steps_actions:
1. Switch the calendar to weekly daily-style mode.
2. Select Teacher T1 in the teacher filter.
3. Wait for calendar data to load.
steps_result:
1. Mode switches successfully.
2. Teacher T1 is applied as active filter.
3. The schedule for Teacher T1 is displayed across 7 days in daily-style layout.
steps_data:
1. mode = weekly_daily_style
2. teacher = T1
3. week = current

title: Calendar Weekly Daily-Style View - Seven Consecutive Days - Calendar displays one full week in date order
description: Layout integrity — The view shows 7 consecutive days sorted by date from the selected week.
preconditions:
- Weekly daily-style mode is open.
- Teacher T1 is selected.
steps_actions:
1. Open weekly daily-style view for a known week.
2. Read the day/date headers from left to right.
3. Compare header order.
steps_result:
1. Calendar renders the weekly board.
2. Exactly 7 day columns are shown.
3. Headers are arranged in chronological order for the selected week.

title: Calendar Weekly Daily-Style View - Actual Lesson Duration - Lesson cards reflect real time length
description: Visual accuracy — Lessons are rendered with height/length matching their actual scheduled duration, similar to Daily View.
preconditions:
- Weekly daily-style mode is open.
- Teacher T1 has at least 2 lessons with different durations in the same week.
steps_actions:
1. Open the weekly daily-style view for Teacher T1.
2. Locate Lesson A and Lesson B with different durations.
3. Compare visual block lengths against scheduled times.
steps_result:
1. Teacher T1 schedule is displayed.
2. Both lesson cards are visible in the grid.
3. Longer lesson occupies visibly more vertical space/time range than shorter lesson, consistent with actual duration.

title: Calendar Weekly Daily-Style View - Multi-location Visibility - Teacher lessons from different locations are shown in one weekly surface
description: Cross-location visibility — Staff can review the selected teacher's lessons from different locations in the same weekly daily-style schedule.
preconditions:
- Weekly daily-style mode is open.
- Teacher T1 has lessons in the selected week across multiple locations.
steps_actions:
1. Open weekly daily-style view for Teacher T1.
2. Locate lessons from Location A and Location B in the week.
3. Inspect lesson labels/details.
steps_result:
1. Schedule grid loads.
2. Lessons from both locations are present in the weekly view.
3. Each lesson shows the correct location context without requiring a different view mode.
steps_data:
1. teacher = T1
2. locations = A_and_B
3. expected_location_display = correct

title: Calendar Weekly Daily-Style View - Teacher Scope - Only selected teacher's lessons are shown
description: Filter correctness — The view is scoped to the selected teacher and does not mix in lessons from other teachers.
preconditions:
- Weekly daily-style mode is open.
- Teacher T1 and Teacher T2 both have lessons in the same week.
steps_actions:
1. Select Teacher T1 in weekly daily-style view.
2. Review visible lesson cards for the week.
3. Switch filter to Teacher T2 and reload the week.
steps_result:
1. Filter is applied.
2. Only lessons assigned to Teacher T1 are shown.
3. View refreshes to show only Teacher T2 lessons; Teacher T1 lessons are no longer visible.
steps_data:
1. teacher = T1
2. expected_teacher_scope = T1_only
3. teacher = T2

title: Calendar Weekly Daily-Style View - Empty-day Handling - Days with no lessons remain visible with empty timeline
description: Negative layout — A day without lessons still appears in the 7-day range and does not collapse the weekly board.
preconditions:
- Weekly daily-style mode is open.
- Selected teacher has no lessons on at least one day in the target week.
steps_actions:
1. Open weekly daily-style view for a week containing at least one no-lesson day.
2. Locate the day column with no lessons.
3. Observe the empty timeline area.
steps_result:
1. Weekly grid loads.
2. The day column is still rendered.
3. No lesson cards are shown for that day, but the day header and timeline remain intact.
steps_data:
1. teacher = T1
2. expected_empty_day = visible
3. empty_state = no_cards

title: Calendar Weekly Daily-Style View - Week Navigation - Previous and next week keep mode and teacher filter
description: Navigation flow — Moving between weeks keeps the selected mode and teacher context while refreshing data to the new 7-day range.
preconditions:
- Weekly daily-style mode is open.
- Teacher T1 is selected.
steps_actions:
1. In weekly daily-style view, click Next Week.
2. Observe active controls after navigation.
3. Click Previous Week to return.
steps_result:
1. Calendar moves to the next 7-day range.
2. Weekly daily-style mode and Teacher T1 filter remain selected.
3. Original week reloads with the same mode and teacher filter intact.
steps_data:
1. nav = next_week
2. expected_state = mode_and_teacher_persist
3. nav = previous_week

title: Calendar Weekly Daily-Style View - Dense schedule readability - Overlapping or adjacent lessons remain distinguishable
description: Readability — When a teacher has a busy week/day, lesson cards remain distinguishable and usable in the daily-style weekly layout.
preconditions:
- Weekly daily-style mode is open.
- Teacher T1 has multiple lessons on the same day, including adjacent or close time slots.
steps_actions:
1. Open weekly daily-style view for the dense-schedule day.
2. Inspect adjacent lesson cards in the same day.
3. Click each lesson card in sequence.
steps_result:
1. The target day column is visible.
2. Cards do not visually merge incorrectly; boundaries between lessons remain clear.
3. Each card is individually selectable and opens the correct lesson detail/interaction target.
steps_data:
1. teacher = T1
2. density = adjacent_lessons
3. action = open_lesson

title: Calendar Weekly Daily-Style View - Regression - Existing calendar views remain unchanged
description: Regression — Adding the new weekly daily-style mode does not break existing daily view and standard weekly view behavior.
preconditions:
- Logged in as staff user with calendar access.
- Existing daily view and weekly view are available.
steps_actions:
1. Open existing Daily View and verify normal rendering.
2. Switch to standard Weekly View and verify rendering.
3. Return to weekly daily-style mode.
steps_result:
1. Daily View behaves as baseline.
2. Standard Weekly View behaves as baseline.
3. New mode remains available without affecting the other view modes.
steps_data:
1. view = daily
2. view = weekly_standard
3. view = weekly_daily_style
